answer_1.quote: The model assumes three main roles: as an actor, it generates responses to given prompts; as a judge, it evaluates and scores its own responses; and as a meta-judge, it compares two of its judgements.
answer_1.outputs: Model-generated responses to user instructions or prompts

answer_2.quote: We make use of three well-established auto-evaluation benchmarks based on GPT4-as-a-Judge: AlpacaEval 2 , Arena-Hard and MT-Bench. We also calculate Spearman correlation and agreement with a strong AI judge (gpt-4-1106-preview).

answer_3.quote: The judge evaluates each response using an LLM-as-a-Judge prompt ... The meta-judge evaluates the judge's judgments using a LLM-as-a-Meta-Judge prompt.
